Definition: Percentage of national population with access to electricity (grid or off-grid). This is the primary indicator of energy infrastructure availability for ICT. Based on World Bank/IEA Tracking SDG7 data, national statistical offices, or Afrobarometer surveys.
Comments: World Bank reported Nigeria access to electricity = 61.2% of population in 2023 (WDI/SDG7 electrification dataset).
revision_notes: Cited World Bank/ESMAP Tracking SDG7 source fetched and confirmed: Nigeria's electricity access rate was 61.2% in 2023, corroborated by Trading Economics, Statista and TheGlobalEconomy.com (all citing the same World Bank dataset). No more recent official figure (2024/2025) is yet published. 61.2% falls within the 50-74% band, matching the original Value Code of 3.
